cands.title: File:Harvested Corn Fields - Badsworth - geograph.org.uk - 56482.jpg
cands.desc: Harvested Corn Fields - Badsworth. These fields, the Upton Beacon and the Upton Rocket on the horizon seemed to cry out to be captured on this late summer's dusk. The rolling hills, frequent small woods and hedgerows typify for me classical English countryside.

cands.desc: View to Hawkswick Moor Looking towards Hawkswick Moor, across the valley, from the Low Ox Pasture wall corner. The River Skirfare flows in the valley below.
